d: US President Donald Trump is reportedly facing a cold response from North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. According to a Wall Street Journal report, Trump tried contacting Kim through phone calls and other communication channels in 2025, but received no response. He later sent a personal letter, which was handed to a North Korean diplomat in New York. However, the diplomat reportedly returned it unopened in front of a US representative. Trump also explored the possibility of meeting Kim during his recent Asia visit, but the meeting never materialised. What is behind Kim's silence?
